title: AnalyzerInstallResult
description: Extended install result including policy pack information

installed.description: Whether the analyzer is currently installed

version.description: Installed analyzer version (empty if not installed)

path.description: Full filesystem path to the installed binary

method.description: Installation method for the Pulumi plugin binary

needs_update.description: True when installed version differs from current binary

current_version.description: Version of the running finfocus binary

policy_pack_dir.description: Path to the policy pack directory (empty if not set up)

policy_pack_method.description: Installation method for the policy pack binary
